quote: You like moving fast? May I introduce you to the **Indianapolis 500**? The Greatest Spectacle in Racing. Three hundred thousand people packing into a single venue to watch machines break the laws of physics at 230 miles an hour. It’s the largest single-day sporting event on the planet, and it happens right in our backyard.
